title: Accessibility & inclusion
shortDescription: Accessible interface components and live translation between advisers and users.
longDescription: Projects that make digital services usable by people with disabilities or who do not speak French: interface components and the reading assistance centre of the Design System, used on francetravail.org among others, and live translation during an interview.

title: Responsible digital
shortDescription: A reference framework, kits and training to design more sober digital services.
longDescription: An eco-design best practice framework, an awareness path adapted to each role (developers, designers, PM/PO) and a one-day training on responsible AI.

title: AI & data
shortDescription: Prepare data, serve language models, measure their performance and their biases.
longDescription: Building blocks from France Travail data teams: a data science project template, text preprocessing, embedding comparison, an API to serve language models, a performance benchmark and fairness measurement. Several projects are no longer maintained: their status is shown on each card.

title: Services for users
shortDescription: The code of applications used by job seekers, young people and advisers.
longDescription: France Travail business applications: support for young people in the Youth Engagement Contract, for advisers and young people alike, and the collection of verified trainee reviews of training courses.

title: Tools and practices for teams
shortDescription: Guides, practices and tools for teams building with or for France Travail.
longDescription: The guide to consuming France Travail APIs, architecture practices (Domain-Driven Design, ADR, Wardley Maps, Team Topologies) and everyday tools, such as an Excel import widget for Grist.
